review_type: finite-group table layout and browser review
canonical_data_source: indexes/catalog.json generated from existing catalogue records

layout_comparison.classification: The simple-family blocks make the classification hierarchy legible. Cyclic and alternating families precede six classical and ten exceptional families; the Tits group has a separate boundary panel, followed by the 26 sporadics.
layout_comparison.all_groups: Equally prominent family tiles are retained as the alternate. It makes low-rank and familiar variants easier to compare, but is less clear as the initial classification map. Families remain separate from individual groups; only individual groups are numerically ordered.
layout_comparison.sporadic_alternative: Increasing exact order offers a denser size comparison. ATLAS grouping is the more informative default despite the additional vertical space.
mathematical_cautions: Presentation ranks are not displayed as atomic numbers.
ATLAS display groups do not assert direct subgroup containment.
The Tits group is not counted as a sporadic.
Distinct tiles may denote low-dimensional isomorphic groups.
Large displayed orders are marked approximate; exact decimal orders remain available in details.
iterations: Compared both fixture layouts at 390 and 1440 pixels.
Reduced mobile hero and control height, aligned tile header rows, and moved long tile products into the detail panel.
Compared both layouts and sporadic arrangements using the actual 144-record catalogue.
Inspected final HTTPS screenshots with the actual site shell in light and dark themes.

main_https_suite.reader_checks: At both widths: one heading, all sections opened, no missing knowls or math errors, no page overflow, long display formulas contained in horizontal scrollers.
main_https_suite.permanent_reader_coverage: The permanent browser test now includes all 16 checked reader pages, including the orthogonal-helper regression.

content_layout_fix.finding: At 390 pixels, the 399.25-pixel inline isometry-group set-builder formula widened the page to 414 pixels.
content_layout_fix.change: Moved only that formula into a display in the same core. All symbols, conditions, and surrounding hypotheses were preserved.

content_layout_fix.final_retest: Passed over the stable HTTPS preview at 390 and 1440 pixels. Both long formulas start visibly at scrollLeft 0 and scroll horizontally at phone width; the page remains exactly 390 pixels wide.
content_layout_fix.hypothesis_followup: Integration review also made the finite-dimensional vector-space hypothesis explicit, ensuring that the finite base field yields a finite isometry group. The updated hypothesis was verified in the live reader at both widths.
